text:
You are a careful reviewer. You are given a report and the source files its numbers come from.

Check every number in the report against the sources. Look each value up or recompute it: differences, percent
changes, ratios, shares, sums, averages, minimums, maximums and counts. Allow for normal rounding at the precision the
report uses. A value that is cut off at that precision instead of rounded also counts as correct (2.36 for 2.368).
Check that words such as "rose" and "fell" agree with the direction of the change. Mind the units the sources state.
Do not guess: when a number cannot be checked from the sources, list it under could_not_check.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"wrong": [{"line": <line number>, "number": "<the number exactly as written>", "should_be": "<your value>",
            "why": "<a few words>"}],
 "could_not_check": [{"line": <line number>, "number": "<as written>"}]}

{"wrong": [{"line": 11, "number": "8.5 percent", "should_be": "9.30 percent", "why": "South revenue 2023 vs 2022 is 221438157/202596667, about +9.30%"}, {"line": 13, "number": "60.2%", "should_be": "20.2%", "why": "South margin in 2022 is 20.2 in the source table"}, {"line": 14, "number": "165,041", "should_be": "165,341", "why": "Central units in 2024 are 165341"}, {"line": 18, "number": "14.96 percent", "should_be": "13.01 percent", "why": "East 2023 units 105491 / total 810615 is about 13.01%"}, {"line": 19, "number": "-6.39%", "should_be": "-6.40%", "why": "East headcount 7040 vs 7521 is -6.395%, which rounds to -6.40%"}, {"line": 21, "number": "$1,289,868,790", "should_be": "$1,421,677,031", "why": "Sum of 2025 costs across the five regions"}, {"line": 24, "number": "$215.05", "should_be": "$142.82", "why": "West 2021 price is 142.82; 215.05 is Central 2021"}, {"line": 26, "number": "9.1%", "should_be": "8.4%", "why": "Central 2024 revenue 147874785 / total 1765216709 is about 8.38%"}, {"line": 27, "number": "1 of the five years", "should_be": "3 of the five years", "why": "East margins at or above 10 are in 2021, 2022 and 2025"}], "could_not_check": [{"line": 3, "number": "2026-12-01"}, {"line": 4, "number": "v1.2.9"}, {"line": 4, "number": "40"}, {"line": 5, "number": "2025"}, {"line": 32, "number": "168"}, {"line": 33, "number": "0.45"}]}
